name: Perplexity API
tagline: Search-grounded LLM API with real-time web results and citations
description: Perplexity API provides OpenAI-compatible chat completions powered by Sonar models that ground answers in live web search with citations. Developers call a REST endpoint with an API key for grounded Q&A, research, and retrieval-augmented generation without managing their own search stack.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header; create keys in Perplexity account settings (self-serve)

example.request: curl -X POST https://api.perplexity.ai/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"sonar","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"What is the capital of France?"}]}'

use_cases: answer a factual question with live web grounding and citations
research a current topic and return sources
summarize recent news on a company or product
compare products using up-to-date web information
